card.fires_on: The word right before a likely 'clinical' or 'clinically' in drug-label text, such as 'complete' in 'complete or partial resolution', 'logic' in 'neurologic', or 'on' in 'based on'.

modes.label: Diagnosis basis
modes.description: 'on' after 'based' in a statement of how a diagnosis is made.
